verdict.rationale: Baseten has a dedicated pricing-and-limits page. It states that Model APIs enforce request and token rate limits and exposes headers such as x-ratelimit-remaining-requests. It also references Basic, Pro and Enterprise tiers, with limits raised via email verification or an upgrade. However, the evidence shows no actual limit values or how they scale per tier, and limits for dedicated deployments are not covered. Missing for 10: concrete per-tier rate limit numbers, an explicit tier-scaling table, limits for dedicated deployments, independent corroboration.
